about: The research's breaks: research.harness.clean.split_breaks over the whole development spot_1d panel gives, for each asset below, the first bar of each later part (X~2, X~3, ...). duo/sys_data.py names its live columns from this, so a break older than the 600-day window still gets the research's X~N name. tests/test_sys_parity.py checks this table against the research's own splits.
